cast.title: Descendants Remix Dance Party
cast.overview: Let's set it off Descendants style! Travel to the Isle of the Lost for a high-energy dance party in the Club Ember hosted by Hades, featuring musical performances of reimagined Descendants hits.

cast.title: The Map That Leads to You
cast.original_title: The Map That Leads to You
cast.overview: Heather is a young woman traveling Europe with friends before starting her perfectly planned life. A chance meeting with Jack sparks an unexpected romance that leads to deep emotional discovery. As secrets and life choices test their bond, her path changes forever.

cast.title: Back of the Net
cast.overview: A new student at a soccer academy is determined to beat her rival's team in the national tournament.

cast.title: Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron
cast.overview: Ironheart, AKA Riri Williams, is having difficulty adjusting to college life as the youngest student there when the college's engineering lab is demolished by an alien and her best friend is kidnapped. Inspired by Iron Man, she develops a plan to save her friend.

cast.title: Marvel Rising: Battle of the Bands
cast.original_title: Marvel Rising: Battle of the Bands
cast.overview: On the day of Gwen’s “Battle of the Bands” competition, mysterious attacks force her and the Secret Warriors to investigate. Can they save the city and get Gwen to the concert on time?

cast.original_title: High School Musical: The Musical: The Series: The Special
cast.overview: An exclusive look into the making of High School Musical: The Musical: The Series.

cast.title: High School Musical: The Musical: The Holiday Special
cast.original_title: High School Musical: The Musical: The Holiday Special
cast.overview: The cast of “High School Musical: The Musical: The Series” delivers an abundance of feel-good holiday cheer as they perform their favorite Christmas, Hanukkah and New Year’s songs and share their fondest holiday memories.

cast.title: The Disney Family Singalong
cast.overview: Ryan Seacrest hosts a nationwide singalong event featuring celebrities and their families as they take on their favorite Disney tunes from their homes; onscreen lyrics allow viewers to sing along.

cast.title: The School for Good and Evil
cast.original_title: The School for Good and Evil
cast.overview: Best friends Sophie and Agatha navigate an enchanted school for young heroes and villains — and find themselves on opposing sides of the battle between good and evil.

cast.title: Shiver
cast.overview: Grace has been fascinated by a pack of wolves in the woods near her home for years. She is particularly drawn to a yellow-eyed wolf, whom she believes is her own. Meanwhile, Sam is a boy who lives as a wolf in the winter and a human in the summer. When Grace meets a yellow-eyed boy who seems familiar, she realizes it must be her wolf. However, as winter approaches, Sam must struggle to maintain his human form or risk losing himself and Grace forever.

cast.title: The Lottery
cast.overview: Five estranged childhood friends reunite for what’s meant to be one last carefree weekend at their remote ski cabin. When they discover they’re holding a winning $300 million lottery ticket, their lives change overnight. But as a brutal blizzard traps them inside, long-buried secrets, old rivalries, and competing ambitions ignite, turning celebration into a dangerous game of greed and deception.

cast.title: Girl
cast.overview: in an exclusive coastal community, the film follows a grieving police chief whose search for justice after his daughter's death uncovers a web of privilege, forbidden relationships, obsession, and devastating secrets, where the greatest threat has been hiding in plain sight all along.

cast.title: Girl
cast.overview: Follows the aftermath of a tennis instructor being found viciously murdered in a summer beach town where wealth and status control everything; a local cop must look deep into the instructor’s last days and his own complicated past to get to the bottom of the twisted case.
